headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, while the Kansas City Royals fell short in Minnesota. The Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, and the New York Yankees shut out the Chicago Cubs 2-0.

Top news saw the Rays edge out the Rangers in a closely contested game, with Jonny DeLuca leading the Rangers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run. The Royals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Minnesota Twins, with Kody Clemens hitting a grand slam in the game, his 19th of the season. The Yankees fell short in Chicago, unable to overcome a strong performance from the White Sox pitching staff. The Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the Detroit Tigers placing Matt Vierling on the 10-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The Seattle Mariners also placed J.P. Crawford on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 30, 2026, with left wrist inflammation. The New York Mets placed Cionel Pérez on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 30, 2026, with a left forearm strain.

Several trades and roster movements took place, with the Minnesota Twins acquiring A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick. The Detroit Tigers traded C Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for RHP Zane Barnhart. The Los Angeles Angels traded C Logan O'Hoppe and RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for SS Angel Arredondo.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Texas Rangers 3-2 in a closely contested game. Jonny DeLuca led the Rangers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Steven Matz pitched 2 scoreless innings for the Rangers.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Minnesota Twins, with Kody Clemens leading the Royals' offense. Clemens hit a grand slam in the game, his 19th of the season.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, unable to overcome a strong performance from the White Sox pitching staff.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren and Shota Imanaga leading the pitching effort. Amed Rosario, Spencer Jones, and Pedro Ramírez were among the key contributors for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Tigers Place Matt Vierling on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers center fielder Matt Vierling has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Minter Joins Twins in Blockbuster Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins acquired left-handed pitcher A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for shortstop Bruin Agbayani and third baseman Billy Amick. The trade was announced on July 31, 2026.
